=== ProjectForge 8.2 snapshot (2026-10-05)

[.changelog-source]
__2026-10-05, snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/203115800[develop@203115800], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/e944881b0..203115800[changes since e944881b0]__ +++{% include release-pills.html %}+++

- **Wicket removed:** last pages migrated to projectforge-next
- **Problem dashboard** with prioritized error digest mails
- **Order statistics** page with budget scenario
- Robust interfaces: timeouts, connection pools, sync statistics
- Spring Boot 4.1, Hibernate 7.4, Kotlin 2.3

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Wicket removed:** DATEV import, log viewer, HR planning, Gantt charts, calendars, to-dos and more migrated to projectforge-next; the module projectforge-wicket was deleted.
- **Problem dashboard:** log events classified and aggregated into problems with a persistent status, JSON export for an AI-assisted analysis, prioritized error digest mails instead of one mail per error.
- **Statistics:** order statistics page with filter, charts, budget scenario and lost-budget warnings; invoicing quota in __My statistics__; contribution margin tab in the order book.
- **Filters:** configurable customer groups and business units as filters for time sheets, invoices, projects and orders.
- **Gateway:** delta sync with nightly full sync, CardDAV favorites and a public heartbeat.
- **Calendar:** ICS import of team events with a diff preview; failing subscriptions are retried less often and deactivated after 90 days.
- **Interfaces:** timeouts, connection pools and sync statistics for LDAP, identity provider, iCal, SMS and Sipgate.
- **Fixes:** subscribed calendar parsing, MS Project export of Gantt charts, Kotlin scripts in the fat jar, password reset button and mail details.
- **Security and technology:** access checks for all new REST endpoints enforced by an architecture test; Spring Boot 4.1, Spring 7, Hibernate 7.4, Tomcat 11, Kotlin 2.3, Gradle 9.8.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
The classic Wicket user interface is gone: the last pages were migrated to projectforge-next and the module projectforge-wicket was deleted.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- **Problem dashboard**
  * Log events are classified at the call site and aggregated in the database with a persistent problem status.
  * Dashboard of all problems, with links into the log viewer and an export as JSON for an AI-assisted analysis.
  * Prioritized error digest mails per audience (HTML, new design) instead of one mail per error; early digest for new security and data problems.
  * Error figures in the system statistics.
- Order statistics page with its own filter, favorites, charts, data tables, budget scenario and warnings about lost budgets.
- Invoicing quota as a tab in __My statistics__.
- Gateway: delta sync with a nightly full sync including deletions and CardDAV favorites, public heartbeat, data transfer UI after OAuth2 login.
- Kost2: shared cost flag, overriding the structure element (also in the mass update).
- ICS import of team events with a diff preview; download of a team event as ics file; shared subscription dialog for time sheets, holidays and weeks of year.
- Run several development instances side by side (`+bin/pfDev.sh+` slots).

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- **Migrated to projectforge-next**
  * DATEV import with view log button, readable import log and account/cost unit tooltips.
  * Log viewer, HR planning, HR view, Gantt charts, report objectives, to-dos, IHK plugin and the internal data transfer UI (area page as tabs, files as a sortable table).
  * Calendar and team calendar pages, cost 1/2 Excel export; the remaining gaps against the Wicket pages were closed before their removal.
- Configurable customer groups and business units; time sheets, invoices, projects and orders can be filtered by business unit, customer and project (checklist filters).
- Order book: contribution margin tab including the year before last.
- Mass update for to-dos and for the payment type of salaries.
- Calendar subscriptions that keep failing are retried less often and deactivated after 90 days.
- Timeouts, connection pools and sync statistics for LDAP, identity provider, iCal, SMS and Sipgate clients.
- The browser window is named after the page; the open tab of list and report pages is kept in the URL.
- Shift+click selects a range in attachment lists.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Subscribed calendars: DTSTAMP no longer breaks parsing; events without DTEND derive their end from DURATION; one event per holiday and week in the feeds.
- MS Project export of Gantt charts repaired (mpxj upgraded).
- Kotlin script classes are resolved in the fat jar again.
- Password reset button, birthday mail locale and inline logo in mails.
- The JCR sanity check runs only once per night.
- Expected client and authentication failures are logged below error level.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- Access checks for all new REST endpoints, enforced by an architecture test.
- npm security advisories in next and webapp patched.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="removed" %}
++++
- Module projectforge-wicket including all Wicket pages, about 90 Wicket-only i18n keys and libraries no longer used.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="technology" %}
++++
- Spring Boot 4.1, Spring 7, Hibernate 7.4, Hibernate Search 8.4, Tomcat 11 (via Spring Boot 3.5 as intermediate step).
- Kotlin 2.3, JUnit 6, Gradle 9.8, kotlin-logging 7.
====

=== ProjectForge 8.2 snapshot (2026-10-02)

[.changelog-source]
__2026-10-02, snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/e944881b0[develop@e944881b0], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/1cc142d51..e944881b0[changes since 1cc142d51]__ +++{% include release-pills.html %}+++

- Accounts, address campaigns, licenses and customers migrated
- **Invoices:** cancellation, Word template choice, LibreOffice PDF

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Migrated to projectforge-next:** accounts, address campaigns, license management and customers (Wicket pages removed); customer and free-text customer merged into one field.
- **Invoices:** a cancellation sets the original invoice to __cancelled__; Word template choice for the ZUGFeRD export, PDF rendered with LibreOffice; empty e-invoice fields filled from the account.
- **Order and invoice forms:** customer column, highlighted head, tinted position headers, sibling cost units in the cost assignment pickers.
- **Usability:** labels and values can be copied; change history shows user and group lists as a diff by name; liquidity planning highlights negative balances.
- **Fixes:** no time sheets on ended or deleted projects, cost assignment index of invoices kept, positions sorted by number, forecast charts match the list, Word-to-PDF works again.
- **Security:** 2FA required for migrated system and plugin pages and the liquidity series split.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- **Migrated to projectforge-next**
  * Accounts, address campaigns and license management (Wicket pages removed).
  * Customers: Wicket pages removed; customer and free-text customer merged into one field.
- **Invoices**
  * Cancellation sets the original invoice to __cancelled__; explained on the button and in the form, with a warning not to change the amounts.
  * Choice of the Word template for the ZUGFeRD export; the invoice PDF is rendered with LibreOffice and the installed fonts.
  * Empty e-invoice fields are filled from the account; cancellation invoices are supported by the Word template.
  * Charts show which list filter they applied; state filters are left out of the year comparison.
- Order and invoice forms: customer column, highlighted head, tinted position headers, sibling cost units in the cost assignment pickers.
- Labels, select values, pickers and section titles can be copied.
- Monthly report: the cost type is only shown for customer cost units.
- Change history shows user and group lists by name as removed/added diff.
- Liquidity planning: negative balances highlighted, credit/debit bars in green/red.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Time sheets can no longer be booked on structure elements of an ended or deleted project.
- Saving an invoice no longer shifts the index of its cost assignments.
- Positions of orders, invoices and incoming invoices are sorted by number.
- Order forecast charts and Excel select exactly the orders of the list.
- Word-to-PDF conversion works again (OpenPDF dropped).

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- 2FA required for the migrated system and plugin pages and the liquidity series split.
====

=== ProjectForge 8.2 snapshot (2026-09-30)

[.changelog-source]
__2026-09-30, snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/1cc142d51[develop@1cc142d51], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/81c69f854..1cc142d51[changes since 81c69f854]__ +++{% include release-pills.html %}+++

- Many more pages migrated to projectforge-next
- **Liquidity planning:** recurring series
- **Order book:** net sum calculator, forecast charts, over-invoicing flags
- Fix: N+1 query floods and cache self-deadlocks

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Migrated to projectforge-next:** monthly employee report, customers, projects, cost 2 units and types, accounting records, salaries, access rights with matrix view, system and plugin administration, liquidity planning.
- **Liquidity planning:** recurring series with a scope choice when editing, tri-state paid status and mass update.
- **Order book and invoices:** net sum calculator per position, forecast and net sum charts, invoicing quota, __to be invoiced__ limited to this month, over-invoiced orders flagged, cancellation of e-invoices, clone an order as a draft.
- **Usability:** structure element picker with recent entries and favorites, compact top navigation with counter badges, deleted references struck through, mass update for cost 1 and cost 2.
- **Fixes:** N+1 query floods, cache self-deadlocks in write transactions, issued invoices shown in the order immediately, planned and cancelled invoices no longer count as invoiced.
- **Security:** deleted groups never grant access rights; 2FA for the migrated access rights and cost 2 forms.
- **Removed:** classic Wicket pages for search, order book, outgoing invoices, monthly report and plugin administration.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- **Migrated to projectforge-next**
  * Monthly employee report with month pager, week drill-downs and compact statistics; normal users can view their own report.
  * Customers, projects, cost 2 units, cost 2 types, accounting records, employee salaries and the salary import.
  * Group/structure element access rights with matrix view, analysis filter for likely erroneous entries, mass update and bulk delete/restore.
  * System administration, plugin administration, system configuration, first-run setup, send SMS, direct call, personal statistics and feedback.
  * The liquidity planning plugin.
- **Liquidity planning**
  * Recurring series with virtual and materialized occurrences and a deliberate scope choice when editing a series.
  * Tri-state paid status, automatic paid flag and mass update including delete/restore.
- **Order book and invoices**
  * Fold-out net sum calculator per order position, persisted with its breakdown.
  * Forecast charts tab in the order book, net sum charts for outgoing invoices, invoicing quota chart.
  * __To be invoiced__ only counts what is due this month; filter split into this month and following months.
  * Over-invoiced orders are flagged red; shortfalls of orders marked as fully invoiced are shown.
  * Cancellation of outgoing e-invoices; cancelled invoices are struck through in the list.
  * Clone an order into a fresh editable draft.
- Structure element picker with recently selected structure elements and structure element favorites.
- Creditor invoices: bank details are filled in from the creditor.
- Mass update for cost 1 and cost 2.
- Compact top navigation with counter badges; search moved into the main menu.
- Deleted or deactivated referenced objects are struck through in list cells.
- Temporary page size of 10,000 rows for all lists.
- The link to the classic version is labelled __Old version__ and warns on pages that will be removed.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Several N+1 query floods (structure element favorites, access list, customer list, skill matrix, forecast, salary export, order filters).
- Self-deadlocks of the project/customer caches inside write transactions.
- An issued invoice is shown in its order immediately, not only after the next cache refresh.
- Planned and cancelled invoices no longer count as invoiced for order positions.
- Change history shows time-of-day values in the user's time zone.
- Cost assignments of incoming invoices are exported again.
- Expand/collapse of the classic structure tree restored.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- Deleted groups never grant access rights.
- 2FA required for the migrated access rights, cost 2 and cost 2 type forms.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="removed" %}
++++
- Classic Wicket pages for search, order book, outgoing invoices, monthly report and plugin administration.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="admin" %}
++++
- Legacy XML user preferences are migrated to the JSON store.
====

=== ProjectForge 8.2 snapshot (2026-09-01)

[.changelog-source]
__2026-09-01, snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/0633fde56[develop@0633fde56], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/e8819bffc..0633fde56[changes since e8819bffc]__ +++{% include release-pills.html %}+++

- Invoices, structure tree, calendar and time sheets migrated
- Multi selection, mass update and period filters in lists

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Migrated to projectforge-next:** outgoing and creditor invoices, structure tree and wizard, groups, calendar with team events, time sheet list and form.
- **Lists and forms:** multi selection with mass update for invoices, period filters with paging arrows, server-side paging of order and invoice lists, restore of deleted entries.
- **Usability:** light/dark theme toggle, JIRA issue links in lists and forms, recently used menu entries and quick access search for the menu.
- **Time sheets:** overlapping time sheets allowed for shared cost elements.
- **Invoices:** invoice statistics with a year-earlier comparison.
- **Fixes:** order book and invoices no longer freeze on concurrent cache refreshes, many N+1 query floods removed, large ID lists batched, project managers can save orders again, invoiced amounts survive a restart.
- **Security and Docker:** safe redirect URLs, 2FA again when saving orders and cost centres; Docker container buildable and startable again.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- **Migrated to projectforge-next**
  * Outgoing invoices with clone, Word and e-invoice export, cost assignments and attachments; creditor invoices with CSV import.
  * Structure tree (tree and list perspective, keyboard navigation), structure element edit page and structure wizard.
  * Groups, including member mail addresses and LDAP information.
  * Calendar with toolbar, favorites, settings, drag and drop, jump to date; team events with reminders, recurrence and series modification.
  * Time sheet list and edit form with recent entries, templates, location suggestions, consumption bar and PDF/Excel export.
- **Lists and forms**
  * Multi selection with an explicit selection mode, mass update for invoices.
  * Period filters (month, term, year to date) with paging arrows; date pickers reaching beyond the current year.
  * Server-side paging of order and invoice lists; generic sorting by computed columns.
  * Deleted entries can be restored; links of moved pages lead to the new pages.
- JIRA issue links in structure element, structure tree, order and time sheet lists and forms.
- Light/dark theme toggle, logos adapted to dark mode.
- Overlapping time sheets allowed for shared cost elements.
- Recently used menu entries, shared by all frontends; quick access search for the menu.
- Invoice statistics with a year-earlier comparison.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Order book and invoices no longer freeze when two caches refresh at once (cross-lock deadlock); invoice cache no longer refreshes inside a write transaction.
- Many N+1 query floods (order list, invoice lists, data transfer audit job, vacation events, employees, books, groups).
- Large ID lists are batched to stay under the database's bind parameter limit.
- Project managers can save orders in the new frontend again.
- Customer name search finds words inside the name.
- Invoiced amounts survive a restart.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- Redirect URLs can no longer smuggle in a foreign host.
- Saving orders and cost centres asks for a second factor again.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="docker" %}
++++
- Docker container is buildable and startable again; step by step guide for a test instance.

[discrete#release-8-2-snapshot-20260816.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 8.2 snapshot (2026-08-16)

[.changelog-source]
__2026-08-16, snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/e8819bffc[develop@e8819bffc], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/0095d878f..e8819bffc[changes since 0095d878f]__ +++{% include release-pills.html %}+++

- First snapshot with **projectforge-next** under `+/next+`
- New login with 2FA under `+/next/login+`
- Order book, books and Kost1 in the new frontend
- Security: CSRF protection, stay-logged-in tokens per device

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **projectforge-next:** the new frontend runs side by side with the existing one under `+/next+`; every migrated page links back to its classic counterpart.
- **Login:** login, two-factor authentication and password reset; `+/next/login+` is the only login of the application.
- **Tables:** column reordering and pinning, persisted layouts, filter panel, filter pills and saved filter favorites.
- **Migrated pages:** books, Kost1 and the order book with positions, payment schedule, statistics and exports; attachments and change history as a tab.
- **Forecast and orders:** configurable distribution of unused budget, run-rate extrapolation, probability of occurrence shown.
- **Further additions:** reindexing as a cancellable job, clone button for Merlin templates, response compression.
- **Fixes:** regressions after the TanStack migration, invoiced order sums no longer 0, identity provider ID kept on user edit, history value search, order notification mails.
- **Security:** stay logged in with one token per device, filter chain review, CSRF protection and full field validation for REST writes.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
First snapshot with **projectforge-next**, the new frontend that runs side by side with the existing one under `+/next+`.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- **projectforge-next**
  * Login, two-factor authentication and password reset; `+/next/login+` is the only login of the application.
  * Tables with column reordering, pinning, persisted layouts, filter panel, removable filter pills and saved filter favorites.
  * Pages declared from the backend's entity metadata; field rules generated from the entities instead of being repeated.
  * Books, Kost1 and the order book (list, edit page with positions and payment schedule, statistics, Excel and forecast exports).
  * Attachments with upload progress, multi selection, ZIP download; change history as its own tab.
  * Every migrated page keeps a link back to its classic counterpart.
- Reindexing as a cancellable job with progress indicator.
- Clone button for Merlin templates.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- Forecast: configurable distribution of unused budget, run-rate extrapolation for call-off and fixed-rate orders.
- Order: probability of occurrence shown; positions marked red only when really due for invoicing.
- Numeric columns right-aligned, time sheet periods sorted chronologically.
- Response compression enabled.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- File transfer, row selection and structure tree regressions after the TanStack migration.
- Identity provider ID no longer cleared on user edit.
- LDAP move/rename of legacy cn-based entries.
- Invoiced sums of orders no longer 0 after concurrent cache refreshes.
- Login redirect no longer overwrites the return URL.
- Search for a value in the change history works again.
- Order notification mails no longer break saving the order.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- Stay logged in: one token per device, throttling, cookie only after 2FA, purge job.
- Security review of the filter chain: trusted proxies, client IP detection, throttling of public key endpoints, unbiased tokens.
- CSRF protection for the REST calls of the new frontend; REST writes validate all fields including string lengths.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="docker" %}
++++
- The Spring profile is no longer lost via the generated environment.sh.
====

__2026-05-31, snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/8f568604c[develop@8f568604c], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/c7b37dd27..8f568604c[changes since c7b37dd27]__ +++{% include release-pills.html %}+++

[.changelog-source]
__2025-09-01, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/8.1-RELEASE[8.1-RELEASE]__ +++{% include release-pills.html tag="8.1-RELEASE" docker="8.1" %}+++

- **Update strongly recommended:** stability and memory fixes
- Fix: major memory leak in data transfer
- Fix: frequent page errors caused by Wicket memory issues
- **AI time savings** in time sheets with reporting
- **Personal menu** customizable via drag and drop
- **Forecast and order book** with planning data and forecast export

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- AI time savings in time sheets with reporting.
- Customizable personal menu via drag and drop.
- Forecast and order book: snapshots, planning data and filterable forecast export.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
[red]##**Update strongly recommended for all users.**## This release fixes a major memory leak in the data transfer module and frequent page errors caused by Wicket memory issues.

[red]##**Update strongly recommended for all users**## - This release fixes a major memory leak in the data transfer module and resolves frequent page errors in web pages (Wicket memory issues).

**Stability proven** - This release has been running stable for many weeks without interruption in two heavily used installations.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- Groups: Description and organization of groups are now visible for non-admins.
- Group Excel export: Includes email addresses of assigned users.
- Menu customization: Drag & drop functionality implemented for personalized menu organization.
- AI time savings tracking in timesheets with calculation and reporting features.
- Cost search functionality supports plain number string searches.
- Timesheet collision prevention on multiple button events.
- Excel export functionality added to accounting record list page.
- User registration process made more user-friendly for new employees.
- Modal dialogs on calendar page support ESC key and click-outside closing.
- 2FA code input field with improved UX (numeric inputmode, autoComplete).
- Excel export of timesheets with AI-savings data included.
- Improved forecast and orderbook functionality with planning data.
- History entries now support user comments for administrative changes.
- Enhanced AG Grid implementation with German translations, filtering, and sorting.
- Vacation validator improvements for edge cases with remaining days from previous year.
- Sipgate contact synchronization service with configurable cron job scheduling.
- Data transfer functionality with sanity checks and backup capabilities.
- JCR memory leak fixes and improved repository management.
- Enhanced user and group access control with menu visibility configuration.
- Forecast export functionality with filtering by unit, customer, and projects.
- Structure wizard support for optional external groups.
- Multi-selection improvements for employees in visitor book and vacation entries.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- JCR memory leaks in DataTransfer module resolved.
- DynamicButton disabled state during fetch operations.
- Accounting record list page tooltips fixed.
- Timesheet recent entries display corrected (kost2, project, customer info).
- VacationValidator edge case handling for vacation day calculations.
- NPE fixes in vacation account management and group services.
- Structure tree access checking improvements for timesheet editing.
- Order forecast data and invoice cache handling corrections.
- User group cache and right handling stability improvements.
- Address forced deletion after MGC migration fixed.
- History formatting and user comment handling corrected.
- Various UI fixes for AG Grid tables and component rendering.
- Excel export XML escaping for structure element titles in timesheet exports.
- Cost assignment export improvements for invoice handling.
- Login redirect functionality after authentication.
- Calendar and timesheet page rendering issues resolved.
- Employee selection improvements without autocompletion quirks.
- Mass update functionality with proper Excel modification tracking.
- Multiple deadlock issues resolved in caching and logging components.
- Wicket session store size increased from 100kB to 2MB: prevents session loss on large pages.
- CSRF token handling and exception registry improvements.
- File stream handling corrections ensuring proper resource closure.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="admin" %}
++++
- Enhanced administration capabilities with user group cache debugging tools.
- System sanity checks with automated error reporting via email.
- Improved cron job scheduling using separate threads to prevent blocking.
- Database testing tools accessible via admin interface.
- Configuration parameter management for AI time savings features.
- Menu item visibility configuration by user groups.
- Enhanced logging and exception handling for proactive error reporting.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- CVE updates: Tomcat upgraded from 10.1.33 to 10.1.39.
- Improved access control for addresses and address campaigns (marketing users only).
- Enhanced user and group visibility restrictions for non-admin users.
- CSRF protection improvements and token handling enhancements.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="technology" %}
++++
- Wicket upgraded to version 10.5.0 with improved page store handling.
- Spring framework updates and dependency management improvements.
- AG Grid integration with advanced filtering, sorting, and column pinning.
- React Router dependency management and compatibility fixes.
- Enhanced Kotlin coroutines implementation for asynchronous operations.
- JCR (Java Content Repository) improvements with RDB storage preparation.
- Jackson library updates with Hibernate 6 module integration.
- Excel processing improvements with Apache POI enhancements.
- Database migration scripts and flyway integration updates.
- Docker container improvements for multi-architecture support preparation.
- Package dependency updates including security patches.
- Gradle build system optimizations and test framework enhancements.
- Source file headers updated to 2025 copyright year.

++++
